newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$8 bln in NCDs on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$8 bln in NCDs on Friday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Friday it would issue T$8 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposits later in the day.
Bids will close at 3.00 pm (0700 GMT), a central bank official said.
The central bank's recent non-stop NCD issuance has widely been seen in the market as aiming to keep a lid on the loose liquidity that many experts say has fuelled a sizzling stock market rally.
The central bank has confirmed that it was responding to the liquidity situation but denied that it was motivated by the stocks rally.
